tr: 连子：同色棋子在同一线上的组合（规则用语）
ex: A row is limited by the board edge, an opponent stone or a free intersection. (RIF 3)

tr: 先手棋，逼迫对方应对的着法
ex: Keep the initiative with forcing moves.
White seized the initiative after the exchange.

tr: 先手（日语借词，落子后对方必须应）
ex: That four is sente: the opponent must block.

tr: 后手（需先应对方的一手）
ex: Playing there first would leave him in gote.
Losing a tempo often decides the game.

Attack where your stones already outnumber his.
There is only one point to block this four.

Deep reading separates the top boards from the rest.
The tesuji turns a lost shape into a win.
A compact shape is easier to defend.

tr: 连五，五子连珠（获胜条件）
ex: Five in a row is an unbroken row with five stones. (RIF 3)

tr: 四，下一手能成五的棋形
ex: A four is a row with four stones to which you can add one more stone to attain five in a row. (RIF 3)
The fours that are open at both ends are "open fours" and cannot be defended. (RenjuNet)

tr: 跳四，中间隔一点的冲四
ex: The broken four points at two different spots.

tr: 三，下一手能成活四的棋形
ex: A three is a row with three stones to which you can add one more stone to attain a straight four. (RIF 3)

tr: 活三，能一步成活四的三
ex: An open three can become an open four with one move, so the opponent should block it. (RenjuNet)
A closed three is far less urgent.
The broken three looks harmless but grows quickly.
Keep your twos alive while blocking his.
Two open twos can turn into a double three.
A double-three is made when one stone creates more than one three meeting in that intersection. (RIF 3)
A double-four is made when one stone creates more than one four meeting in that intersection. (RIF 3)
Black's only allowed winning fork is the four-three (4x3) fork. (RenjuNet)
An overline is an unbroken row consisting of six or more stones; for Black it is forbidden. (RIF 3, 9.2)

tr: 成五点，落子即成五的点
ex: Count the winning points before you attack.
The two points are miai, so defense is hopeless.
That stone is a double threat on two lines.
Black may not make a 3x3 fork, a 4x4 fork or an overline; White has no restrictions. (RenjuNet)
The arbiter called a foul on the overline.
An illegal move must be taken back at once.

tr: 开局规则，平衡先后的办法
ex: Each tournament announces its opening rule in advance.
After the third stone White may swap colors.
Under Swap2 the first player offers three openings.
The pie rule gives the second player a fair choice.

tr: 国际连珠规则（RIF 规则）
ex: The International Rules of Renju were decided by the RIF on 2 May 1996. (RIF)
The Yamaguchi rule is widely used in Chinese events.
Soosõrv rule lets Black name the number of fifth moves.
Taraguchi rule adds a second round of choices.
Under the Sakata rule White may swap after the fourth move.

tr: 直指开局，第二手落在相邻位置
ex: There are thirteen direct openings in renju.

tr: 间接开局，第二手落在间隔位置
ex: Indirect openings leave more room for both sides.

Everyone meets everyone in a round-robin.

With an odd number of players, one gets a bye.

His resignation came two moves before the five.

tr: 连续冲四取胜，Victory by Continuous Fours
ex: He found a VCF that ended in six moves.

tr: 连续威胁取胜，Victory by Continuous Threats
ex: A VCT is harder to see than a VCF.

tr: 弃子，主动送出一子换取攻势
ex: The sacrifice opened a line for the winning four.
A counter-four buys one more move for defense.
Rows are numbered from 1 at the bottom; columns are lettered A to O.

tr: 参照点，盘上五个定位点
ex: Five intersections on the board are reference points. (RIF 2)
A row is limited by a free intersection as well as by the board edge. (RIF 3)
An unbroken row is a row with no free intersection between any stones. (RIF 3)

tr: 活四（直四），两端都能成五
ex: A straight four can become five in a row in two different ways. (RIF 3)
White can defend a half-open four by playing at its single open end. (RenjuNet)

tr: 假三，看似活三其实不能成活四
ex: Many beginners hurry to block fake threes which were not open at all. (RenjuNet)

tr: 一子双杀，同时造出两条攻线
ex: You have a fork if your move creates two fours, a four and an open three, or two open threes. (RenjuNet)

tr: 禁点，黑方不能落子的点
ex: The white player can take advantage of a forbidden point and win the game. (RenjuNet)
A move consists of putting a stone on the board or declaring that you pass. (RIF 5)
The player who wants to win always has to claim win and stop both clocks. (RIF 9.6)

tr: 开局定式，前五手的棋形
ex: Only 13 indirect and 13 direct opening patterns are possible to play. (RIF 11)
A 4x3 fork consists of one four and one OPEN three; a closed three does not win. (RenjuNet)
Both threes of a 3x3 fork must be open threes, otherwise the fork is not winning. (RenjuNet)
